correctness.rationale: A genus-six, unique-break-seven Artin–Schreier cover admits the exhaustive standard equation. Ramification gives div(dx)=10P∞ and six explicit independent holomorphic differentials. The Cartier power-selection identity yields exact images in that basis, making first rank 2 iff a=0 (else 3), second rank 1, third rank 0; therefore a-numbers are 4 and 3. A standalone F9 implementation independently reconstructs the matrix and checks Frobenius-twisted powers on all 729 triples. The symbolic argument—not finite enumeration—proves the all-parameters conclusion.

value.rationale: It classifies the two Cartier/a-number types in the entire natural genus-six p-rank-zero Artin–Schreier stratum of characteristic three, not an arbitrarily selected slice. The jump has an exact codimension-one equation in the exhaustive normal-form parameterization and both sides occur. Such a full-stratum finer-than-p-rank invariant is mathematically motivated by the gaps in the established bounds and low-genus classification and supplies geometric differentiation of curves with identical ramification and p-rank.
